findings: FileSignatureCache documentation explicitly says signatures need not be full byte-for-byte hashes, while actual domain.model.DuplicateGroup documentation calls members byte-for-byte identical. This confirms a semantic contract mismatch between cache recipe and result model.

FileSignatureCache and PHashCache have no algorithm/decoder/color-policy version fields. Both DAOs load all rows, upsert lists and delete path sets without scope/version predicates. Transaction boundaries and schema migrations remain unread.

compositionId hashes sorted item IDs joined with unescaped |. Distinct ID sets such as [a|b,c] and [a,b|c] encode identically before MD5. Whether these characters occur in actual IDs depends on repository construction, still unread.

MediaItem.filePath supports file URI only; content URI yields empty path and file accessor falls back to File(""). Callers must handle URI-based access rather than assuming this File names the item. No file operation executed.

DuplicateGroup.uniqueId is signature only; SimilarGroup.uniqueId is pHash. withUpdatedItems changes members without recalculating signature or sizePerFile, so upstream validation must establish remaining membership validity.
Result model stores sizePerFile rather than computing reclaimable bytes. Actual UI accounting remains unread; no reclaimable-size defect asserted.
